paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的黏度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [abstract][S2.p1]。作者采用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关函数计算黏度，并与实验数据对比 [S2.p1][S3.p1]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较好地重现实验黏度，而经典势预测的黏度偏低，这与经典势低估熔点约 300 K 有关 [abstract][S3.p1][S3.p2]。作者还发现 MACE 通过简单加热晶体结构得到的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract][S3.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型（Buckingham 和 BHM 势）在模拟熔融 LiF 时无法忠实再现热物理数据，尤其是黏度预测存在温度轴上的偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）来改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并检验 MACE-MP-0 势计算黏度的准确性 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟，经典势（Buckingham 和 BHM）通过 DL_POLY 包实现，MACE 机器学习势通过 python 包 janus-core 使用 MACE_MP_0（small 版本）实现 [S2.p1]。两种方法均采用 Green-Kubo 方法，从应力张量自相关函数的积分计算黏度 [S2.p1]。统计收集使用 NVE 系综，时间步长 1 fs，轨迹长度 1 ns，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均；平衡阶段在 NPT 系综中从晶体结构逐步加热 [S2.p2]。MACE 模型基于 Message Passing Neural-Network 架构，使用高阶多体 ACE 展开进行消息传递，训练于 MPtrj 数据集 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of $1$ fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across $20$ initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from $10$ K to the desired temperature in steps of $50$ K.

The MACE model relies upon a Message Passing Neural-Network (MPNN) architecture where the input space is the dynamic local environment around any given atom along with its static properties (e.g. chemical element).

Importantly the MACE model utilises higher-order many-body ACE expansion for message passing to achieve faster and more accurate convergence to ground-truth Density Functional Theory (DFT) energies, forces, and stresses than other similar schemes to build MLIPs.
The model is trained upon the MPtrj data set introduced for CHGNet and compiled from the Material Project dataset, which includes 89 elements (including Li and F) in $\sim 146,000$ materials.

experiments.text: 作者将三种计算模型（MACE、BHM、Buckingham）的黏度结果与实验数据进行比较 [S3.p1]。模拟使用 N=512 原子的体系，作者此前发现对于 LiF 和 Argon 体系的经典势，使用大到 100000 原子的体系对结果影响很小 [S2.p3]。黏度计算的最大相关时间取 5 ps [S2.p3]。作者还通过从晶体结构逐步单调加热至 1250 K 来考察熔点，并计算了速度自相关函数（VAFs）、态密度（DOS）、部分径向分布函数（RDFs）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p2][S3.p4][S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.

In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms, where we have previously found little impact on results from utilising large system sizes up to 100000 atoms for classical potentials in LiF and Argon systems.
For both MD methods we use the same maximum correlation time for calculating $\eta$, $5$ ps.
in Figure 2 we show the system volume $V$ for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to $1250$ K.
First we show the velocity autocorrelation functions (VAFs) of the Buckingham and MACE models in figure 3, with the resultant densities of states (DOS) of each included as insets.
Next we look at the partial RDFs $g(r)$ in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.

findings.text: MACE 模型的黏度结果在整个温度范围内与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型存在已知的偏移，模拟黏度在温度约高 300 K 处才与实验黏度匹配 [S3.p1]。作者观察到 MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，这支持了经典势黏度偏移与其低估熔点约 300 K 有关的观点 [S3.p2]。在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的振荡频率降低，VAF 出现更深的极小值，表明液体运动具有更明显的类固态振荡成分 [S3.p4]。RDF 分析显示 MACE 模拟的配位环境比经典模型更宽，第一和第二峰位置大致相同但峰高略低 [S3.p5]。作者指出，平均结构可以相似，但动力学和输运性质可能差异显著 [S3.p6]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models: the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.

This supports this notion that the poor reproduction of the experimental viscosity in simulations governed by the Buckingham and BHM models is related to the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately $300$ K, ascertained in experiments to be $1121$ K (although 1143 K is also recorded).
We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
In this sense, deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.

The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model, which may be related to the lower frequency oscillation of the Li ions in the MACE simulation.
An interesting insight from the RDF analysis is that average structures can be quite similar, yet dynamics and transport properties can differ substantially as we saw for viscosity results earlier.

limitations.text: 作者承认，从晶体结构逐步加热来确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件排除了实验中的自由表面或界面，且 MD 的小体系尺寸缺少长波长和低频声子，这些因素都会影响熔点位置 [S3.p3]。作者指出，确定熔点并非本工作的重点，而是未来研究的任务 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 无法采用更大的体系来增大计算截断半径以观察 RDF 峰进一步衰减和 g(r) 趋于 1 [S3.p5]。作者还指出，MACE 势虽然能更准确地重现实验性质，但计算负载比经典两体势更高 [S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: For these and other reasons, gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.

however the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.

In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system. For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
